sources.content: # .cursorrules for Ujvelt. Ujvelt is a grocery list app for Android written in Kotlin 2.0 with Jetpack Compose. Build a debug APK with `./gradlew assembleDebug`. Unit tests run with `./gradlew test`, and instrumented tests with `./gradlew connectedAndroidTest` on an emulator running API 34. The minimum SDK is 26. Feature code lives in `app/src/main/java/com/ujvelt/feature/`, one package per screen. Use Hilt for dependency injection; do not create singletons by hand. The application ID is `com.ujvelt.app`.

Rules. Store data only through the Room database in the `data/db` package; schema exports go to `app/schemas/` and must be committed. Every Compose screen needs a preview function and a screenshot test. Strings belong in `res/values/strings.xml`. Network calls use Retrofit with a 15-second timeout. Do not raise `targetSdk` or change signing configs; those changes need the release owner. Run `./gradlew ktlintCheck` before pushing. Load images with Coil, and never send analytics events from debug builds.

claims.text: Ujvelt network calls use a 30-second timeout.
Ujvelt stores data through a Room database.
Ujvelt Room schema exports must be committed.
Ujvelt uses Koin for dependency injection.
Ujvelt instrumented tests run on an emulator with API 34.
